title: View from The Hill: Jobless numbers highlight that the Reserve Bank’s credibility is on the line
paragraphs: Treasurer Jim Chalmers is under enormous pressure over the government’s economic management, but this week’s higher-than- expected unemployment rate underlines that the reputation of Reserve Bank Governor Michele Bullock is increasingly on the line.

We can’t be sure whether the 4.9% October unemployment figure, up from 4.7% in September, gave Bullock any pause for thought about whether the bank made the right decision in raising interest rates at this month’s meeting.
We do know hiking rates was a contested call – taken on a six to three vote – given the economic uncertainty and the danger of depressing activity too far.
